title: How CHN works
subtitle: Follow the steps in order — from team setup to invoices.

overview.title: Overview
overview.summary: The full path from setup to invoice.
overview.body1: 1. Invite your team and set roles. 2. Link partner companies. 3. Create and send a material request. 4. Collect quotes and select lines. 5. Issue or receive an invoice.
overview.body2: Buyers and suppliers work in the same product. Each company controls access with roles and permissions.
overview.body3: Open the steps below in order. Later stages (payments, shipments, consolidations) will appear as those modules open up.

team.title: Team
team.summary: Step 1: Invite people and assign access.
team.before: You already have a company. Start by bringing colleagues in.
team.body1: 1. Open Team and invite members by email.
team.body2: 2. Assign a role (procurement, logistics, accounting, and so on) so each person sees the right modules.
team.body3: 3. Owners can fine-tune permissions per person. When the team is ready, move on to partners.

partners.title: Partners
partners.summary: Step 2: Link companies before any documents move.
partners.before: First set up the team (or continue alone). Partners are required before requests can reach another company.
partners.body1: 1. Open Partners and send a link invitation to a supplier or client.
partners.body2: 2. Wait until the other company accepts — without an active partnership, procurement documents cannot flow.
partners.body3: 3. Accept inbound partner requests if other companies invite you. Then you can create requests.

requests.title: Requests
requests.summary: Step 3: List materials and send them to suppliers.
requests.before: Active partner links must exist before suppliers can receive a request.
requests.body1: 1. (Buyer) Create a material request and add lines with quantities and deadlines — manually or via file import.
requests.body2: 2. (Buyer) Send the request to one or more partner suppliers.
requests.body3: 3. (Supplier) Open inbound requests from clients and prepare to reply with a quote.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.summary: Step 4: Reply with prices, then compare and select.
quotes.before: A request must already be sent to suppliers.
quotes.body1: 1. (Supplier) Open the inbound request and prepare a quote with unit prices, lead times, and terms.
quotes.body2: 2. (Buyer) Compare quotes from different suppliers in one place.
quotes.body3: 3. (Buyer) Select quantities per line — different lines can come from different suppliers. Selected quantities become the basis for the invoice.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.summary: Step 5: Bill for the selected lines.
invoices.before: Complete line selection on quotes before creating an invoice.
invoices.body1: 1. (Supplier) Create an invoice for the quantities the buyer selected.
invoices.body2: 2. (Buyer) Review the invoice; register payment and attach proof when ready (payment is the next stage beyond this guide).
invoices.body3: 3. Invoices stay linked to the earlier request and quote lines so you can always trace where an amount came from.
